name: AgomAb Therapeutics
description: Loss of tissue functionality or organ failure is often a result of inflammatory, metabolic, and fibrotic processes which can occur in a variety of difficult-to-treat diseases. AgomAb aims to resolve these processes by modulating specific regenerative pathways in the target tissue or throughout the body, ultimately leading to a structural repair of tissue and the restoration of organ function.

name: Aldebaran Robotics
description: Aldebaran Robotics was one of Europe’s earliest and boldest robotics pioneers, and for a time one of the few companies anywhere in the world bringing humanoid robots out of research labs and into real-life use cases. Founded in France in 2005 by Bruno Maisonnier, the company gained international recognition with Nao, a programmable humanoid robot adopted by universities, laboratories, and developers worldwide. It later expanded its ambition with Romeo, designed for assistance and companion applications. Aldebaran embodied a rare European attempt to build a global robotics champion, and its journey culminated in its sale to SoftBank, laying the foundations for SoftBank Robotics.

name: arGEN-X
description: arGEN-X is a research-stage biopharmaceutical company with a broadly applicable, proprietary platform called SIMPLE Antibody™. Using this platform, arGEN-X is able to create a wide range of monoclonal antibody leads against a broad range of human disease targets. These antibodies are then given highly competitive properties using other technologies in many cases. The company has proven the benefits of its monoclonal antibody development platform by signing numerous partnerships and pursuing two proprietary clinical programmes.

name: Carbyon
description: Carbyon's direct air capture (DAC) uses an innovative patented technology to capture CO2 directly from the atmosphere. This ‘fast swing’ technology increases CO2 capacity and ensures rapid operation speed, thereby significantly driving down unit, energy, and project costs – all critical criteria to facilitate large-scale deployment. Proxima Fusion helps accelerate the transition to sustainable power by providing a path to safe, continuous, and carbon-free electricity at scale. By combining cutting-edge physics with industrial engineering, it transforms the challenge of fusion energy into a competitive advantage for global energy systems.

name: Corteria Pharmaceuticals
description: Corteria Pharmaceuticals is a French biotechnology company specialized in the development of transformativeTtherapies for the treatment of worsening and acute decompensated heart failure and obesity with established complications.

name: DenyAll
description: DenyAll was a French cybersecurity software company founded in 2001, specializing in next-generation application security. The company developed solutions to detect vulnerabilities, protect infrastructure against sophisticated application-layer attacks, and secure interactions between users, applications, and web services. Headquartered in Sèvres, with operations in Montpellier and Germany, DenyAll built a footprint across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, securing more than 60,000 applications. Its customer base included a significant share of CAC 40 and Euronext companies. Following the 2014 acquisition of BeeWare, its main European rival, DenyAll emerged as a leading independent European application-security platform before its sale to Rohde & Schwarz.

description: Founded in June 2000, DiBcom is a French semiconductor company based on a fabless (no factory) model, that designs, manufactures and sells integrated circuits for receiving Digital Terrestrial television. DiBcom’s solution can be used in any type of terminal and ensures perfect reception of television channels in every situation–including on the move–irrespective of the standard used.

name: DiogenX
description: DiogenX, is a preclinical stage biotech company specializing in the development of pancreatic beta-cell modulators for the treatment of type one diabetes (T1D).

name: Direct Energie
description: Energy supplier in France to businesses, local authorities and consumers.

name: Elistair
description: Created in 2014 and based in Lyon (France), and Boston (USA), Elistair designs and manufactures tethered drone solutions for tactical surveillance and civil defense missions. Elistair’s products are used by armed forces, civil security services and a number of private companies, in more than 60 countries.

name: Emulation and Verification Engineering SA (EVE)
description: Emulation and Verification Engineering SA was founded in April 2002 by a team of specialists from the EDA, predominantly from Meta Systems (Mentor Graphics group). EVE has devised a revolutionary solution for the verification of integrated circuits, which can emulate code using FPGA standards. This platform helps to shorten design times for the complex integrated circuits frequently used in communication devices and more generally in all electronic devices.

name: EnduroSat
description: EnduroSat is a space infrastructure builder that engineers, manufactures, and operates high-performance satellites, making space universally accessible for commercial and institutional customers across the globe. EnduroSat delivers end-to-end satellite missions - from mission design and payload integration to launch and in-orbit operations - through a fixed-cost, constellation-as-a-service model. EnduroSat serves 450+ customers globally and employs more than 350 space professionals across 7 locations worldwide. www.endurosat.com

name: Envivio
description: Founded in 2000, Envivio specialises in MPEG4 encoding and video content delivery on mobile phones and PCs. The company provides a solution enabling TV channels and studios to deliver very high-quality videos, irrespective of the terminal’s read capacity. In 2009, Envivio introduced the first on-demand live video encoding and distribution system for the iPhone OS 3.0. The company’s headquarters are in San Francisco, California and it has offices in Rennes, London, Tokyo and Beijing.

name: Erenis
description: Fibre-optic connections and internet service provider for consumers.

name: IKTOS
description: Iktos is an innovative company specializing in the development of artificial intelligence (AI) and robotics solutions applied to chemical research, more specifically medicinal chemistry and new drug design. The use of Iktos technology platform enables major productivity gains in upstream pharmaceutical R&D.

name: Intersec
description: Intersec designs innovative software enabling companies to leverage their Big Data. Our disruptive technology crunches and consolidates huge amounts of data coming from heterogeneous network equipment and IT, and turns them into actionable insights in real-time. Applications range from Customer Base Management, mass-scale Location-Based Services, Fraud Management and Business Analytics.

name: Jimmy Energy
description: Jimmy designs and operates small modular nuclear reactors to supply its customers with decarbonised heat at a lower cost than that obtained from fossil fuels. Jimmy’s thermal generators are based on high-temperature nuclear micro-reactors (HTRs) that create the desired heat. These reactors are well-known, very hot and very safe.

name: Lithosquare
description: Lithosquare develops an AI-powered platform designed to enhance the mining exploration process with a focus on critical minerals. Its platform is capable of ingesting a wide variety and large volumes of geological data, leveraging AI-driven geological reasoning to accelerate target identification and increase the likelihood of discovering viable prospects.

name: Mipsology
description: Before its acquisition by AMD, Mipsology was a French-American deeptech company founded in 2015 by FPGA veterans. The company built a strong position in AI inference software, first through advanced FPGA compilation technology and later through Zebra, its flagship platform, which enabled TensorFlow, PyTorch and ONNX models to run efficiently on AMD/Xilinx hardware without requiring model redesign. Mipsology stood out for bridging cutting-edge hardware and developer usability, helping bring high-performance inference to industrial and edge applications. By the time of the sale, it had become a respected European specialist and a long-standing AMD partner in AI software.

name: Miyowa
description: Founded in April 2003 by Pascal Lorne and François Colon, Miyowa is a technology enabler delivering solutions to mobile phone operators looking to add community-based services to their offering.

name: Nanomakers
description: Founded in 2010 and based in Rambouillet, the French start-up Nanomakers has been designing and producing since 2012 patented silicon-based nanopowders which transform the mechanical, chemical or thermal properties of materials. Its disruptive technology has made it possible to triple the energy density of Li-ion batteries anodes, or to lighten and reinforce the mechanical properties of certain materials (metal alloys, elastomers) used in various industrial sectors.

name: Novaled
description: German company Novaled has developed a new structure and new doping materials curbing power consumption and extending the life of organic light-emitting diodes (OLED). At the time of the sale, the company owned more than 400 patents.

name: OpenSee
description: Opensee is a French fintech company specializing in real-time big-data analytics for financial institutions. Its platform enables banks and market participants to query and analyze 100% of their stored data at scale, without compromising performance, volume or cost. The company addresses critical use cases such as intraday risk monitoring, trade analytics, regulatory reporting and operational efficiency. Opensee also stands out through Agensee, its agentic AI layer, which allows users to interact with risk, finance and trade data in natural language, automate complex analyses and generate explainable insights in real time. Together, this turns data complexity into a genuine competitive advantage.

name: Own Security
description: OWN is a major French player in cybersecurity, providing tailor-made, informed and adapted support thanks to its DNA of passionate and committed experts. OWN is a pure player in cybersecurity, combining in-depth knowledge of the challenges facing organizations with ongoing awareness of the threats they face. They advise and contribute to the cyber defense efforts of organizations of all sizes and in all sectors, inform and alert when risk is imminent through remediation and cybersecurity improvement actions.

name: Parima
description: PARIMA is a French cultivated-protein company created through the combination of Gourmey and Vital Meat, bringing together advanced cell cultivation, avian biology, bioprocess engineering and food science. Its technology platform spans duck and chicken, uses machine learning to optimize nutrient composition and cell performance, and connects cell cultivation to finished products through predictive, data-driven scale-up. Beyond product innovation, PARIMA addresses a strategic food-security challenge: producing animal proteins in controlled environments that can strengthen supply resilience, improve traceability and reduce dependence on traditional livestock chains. With two sites in France, the company is positioning itself as a sovereign next-generation protein platform.

name: Peoplespheres
description: PeopleSpheres has developped an innovative HR PaaS (Platform as a service) that allows companies to interconect all their HR assets to built a tailor made HR platform. They integrate a large variety of best of breed software building blocks including agentic AI .

name: Planet A Foods
description: Planet A Foods is a next-generation food ingredient company focused on building future-proof, resilient alternatives for the global food industry. Founded in 2021, the company develops ingredients designed to reduce dependence on increasingly constrained and volatile agricultural inputs such as cocoa, palm oil and coffee. Its approach combines food science, industrial processing and natural raw materials to create scalable solutions for manufacturers seeking greater supply security, consistency and sustainability. By addressing both climate exposure and resource scarcity, Planet A Foods positions itself at the intersection of innovation and food-system resilience, helping brands secure long-term access to strategic ingredients in a changing world.

name: Proxima Fusion
description: Proxima Fusion is a European deeptech company developing the first generation of commercial fusion power plants. Spun out of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics, Proxima leverages quasi-isodynamic stellarator technology, advanced simulations, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to turn decades of research into clean, reliable energy for the grid.

name: Qantev
description: Qantev is an artificial intelligence company that helps health insurers deliver better healthcare to their members. Powered by cutting edge machine learning and optimisation to predict patient journeys, Qantev can provide unprecedented insight and automation by leveraging insurers’ historical claim data.

name: Qualtera
description: Qualtera was a semiconductor analytics company helping chipmakers turn vast manufacturing and test data into actionable insights. Its platform combined high-performance big-data infrastructure, real-time analytics and production-control capabilities to give engineering and operations teams visibility across test and manufacturing flows. Qualtera enabled customers to improve design implementation, accelerate yield ramps, strengthen quality control and optimize test efficiency at scale, with faster diagnosis and better operational decisions across the silicon lifecycle. The company stood out for making data-driven decision-making practical in high-volume semiconductor environments, serving industrial companies, OSATs, IDMs and foundries. Its trajectory culminated in its 2020 acquisition by Synopsys.

name: Quandela
description: Co-founded in 2017 by the Professor Pascale Senellart, Dr Niccolo Somaschi and Dr Valérian Giesz, Quandela is a French company that is among the world leaders in quantum photonics. Quandela is known for being the originator of Prometheus, the world’s first photonic qubit generator with broad application domains including quantum cryptography, quantum computing or quantum sensors. The company is developping a full stack quantum computer based on its photonic technology, available on the cloud.

name: Quantum Systems
description: Quantum Systems specializes in the development and production of advanced uncrewed systems, focusing on electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS) for ISR missions. The company’s family of modular, AI-enhanced platforms provides long-endurance autonomous intelligence for defense, security, and geospatial clients. Quantum Systems pursues a multi-domain approach, integrating aerial systems with ground robotics, including the Mandrill UGV and the MOSAIC Ground Autonomy Kit for coordinated air-ground operations. Leveraging edge computing, real-time AI, and open architecture, Quantum Systems delivers versatile, efficient autonomous solutions with minimal infrastructure needs. The company operates from locations in Germany (headquarters in Gilching), the United States (Moorpark, California), Australia, the United Kingdom, Romania, and Ukraine (via strategic partnerships).

name: Qubit Pharmaceuticals
description: Qubit Pharmaceuticals was founded in 2020 with the vision of co-developing, with pharmaceutical and biotech companies, new, more effective and safer drugs. Its software takes full advantage of existing and emerging supercomputers to model quantum effects at the microscopic level with maximum accuracy. The multidisciplinary team and founders are based in France at the Paris Santé Cochin incubator and in the United States in Boston.

name: Scality
description: Highly effective open infrastructure solution for large-scale unstructured data storage

name: SEKOIA.IO
description: Sekoia.io specializes in the development and provision of advanced cybersecurity solutions, focusing on an AI-driven Security Operations Center (SOC) platform for detection and response. The company's platform features modular, intelligence-enhanced tools that deliver proactive threat anticipation, automated detection, and rapid response across diverse attack surfaces, serving clients in enterprises, managed security service providers (MSSPs), and public sector organizations. Sekoia.io adopts a unified, intelligence-centric approach, centering cyber threat intelligence (CTI) at the core of its offerings. This includes proprietary, real-time CTI combined with AI automation to enable comprehensive visibility and control, supporting extended detection and response (XDR) capabilities through open integrations and interoperability. The company maintains its headquarters in France (Rennes), with a European focus and operations supporting global clients.

name: seniorAdom
description: Founded in November 2012, SeniorAdom offers new remote assistance technology. SeniorAdom’s next-generation technology automatically detects falls and sudden illness using a smart system of detectors (no cameras) connected to a central device. This central device is easy to install and use. It can simply be plugged into a power socket (no need for an internet connection because it has an embedded GSM mobile phone card). No special training is required. In addition to falls and sudden illness, SeniorAdom’s solution can also report any unusual patterns in the life of a dependent person by sending a text or email to their carer. Each carer has a personalised and secure space from which they can monitor the well-being of the person living in their own home. SeniorAdom has genuinely disrupted the remote assistance space, which had barely advanced in 35 years. It provides comfort and peace of mind to both carers and service users.

name: Sentryo
description: Sentryo helps organizations embrace the promises of Industry 4.0 innovations by keeping their industrial operations safe from cyber-attacks. Sentryo’s ICS CyberVision award winning platform gives control engineers comprehensive visibility on their industrial control systems, detects anomalies and accelerates response to cybersecurity incidents keeping them ahead of cyber threats. Sentryo has been acquired in 2019 by Cisco.

name: SeqOne Genomics
description: SeqOne Genomics offers high performance genomic analysis solutions for healthcare providers treating patients suffering from cancer, rare and hereditary diseases as well as pharmaceutical companies developing new therapies.

name: Skynopy
description: Skynopy helps satellite operators increase data throughput, reduce revisit times, and operate with greater agility. By combining its own infrastructure with partner ground stations and virtualized modems, Skynopy transforms ground segment complexity into a seamless service, enabling customers to focus on their missions while gaining a competitive edge in a rapidly evolving space industry.

name: SOLVIONIC
description: Founded in 2003 and based in Toulouse, Solvionic produces high-purity ionic liquids, used in new generation batteries, making them more reliable, more powerful and longer lasting.

name: The Exploration Company
description: The Exploration Company’s mission is to democratize space exploration, making it affordable, available and sustainable. To realize this mission, The Exploration Company develops, manufactures and operates Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle that can eventually be refuelled in orbit and uses green propellants. The technical bricks of Nyx are built with open interfaces: they are available on a SpaceStore to enable space & non-space companies to use them and develop new applications. Nyx provides a wide scope of missions ranging from resupplying space stations around the Earth and the Moon, free flying around Earth or landing on the Moon – and safely coming back on Earth. Nyx starts with flying cargo and has the potential to carry humans in the long run.

name: Therapixel
description: Founded in in 2013, by two former National Institute for Research in Digital Science and Technology (INRIA) researchers, Therapixel is a world leader in artificial intelligence applied to medical imaging. Winner of the “Digital Mammography DREAM Challenge” in 2017, Therapixel develops AI-based technology designed to help radiologists to detect breast cancer via mammograms.

name: TISSIUM
description: Founded in 2013, the mission of Tissium is to disrupt the field of surgery and positively impact the lives of patients through the development of its platform of biomorphic programmable polymers.

name: Tronic’s Micro Systems
description: Tronics Micro Systems is a spin-off from CEA Leti (French atomic energy commission’s electronics and information technology facility). The company designs, manufactures and markets high value-added MEMS (micro-electro-mechanical systems) solutions for specific applications in the medical sector, telecoms, aerospace/defence and oil exploration. The company has a presence in France, the United States and China.

name: Trusted Shops
description: The company offers services for online shops to raise customer trust thanks to a solution package combining a quality brand, a money-back guarantee and a customer feedback management service.

name: Unseenlabs
description: Unseenlabs is a French space-tech company founded in 2015, and a European leader in RF-based maritime intelligence from space. The company has developed a proprietary satellite technology capable of detecting and geolocating vessels at sea in near real time, including non-cooperative or dark ships, from a single nanosatellite. By combining in-orbit RF sensing, proprietary payloads and data-processing capabilities, Unseenlabs turns space infrastructure into actionable maritime intelligence. Its services support defence, security, fisheries monitoring, sanctions enforcement and commercial surveillance. In that sense, Unseenlabs stands out as a sovereign European space-tech platform operating at the intersection of satellite constellations, intelligence and maritime domain awareness.

AEPONYX was acquired by Pasqal, a global leader in neutral-atom quantum computing, on June 3, 2025.

name: Airborne
description: Airborne leads in advanced composites, specializing in the industrialization of fiber-reinforced composites for Space, Aeronautics, and Marine industries. With 25 years of expertise, they deliver high-end composite solutions through advanced manufacturing or by developing industrialization packages. Airborne’s focus is on producing high-quality components at high production rates with radically low conversion costs.

name: Ardent
description: Ardent Process Technologies is a high-growth, advanced membrane solutions company, committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the industry and energy landscape. Their Optiperm™ platform delivers scalable, cost-effective carbon capture solutions for cement, steel, and petrochemical industries. With 30 years of experience, Ardent excels in transitioning technologies from lab to field, collaborating with leaders like Chevron and Pfizer to achieve commercial-scale results.

name: Aspect Biosystems
description: Aspect Biosystems is pioneering bioprinted tissue therapeutics to treat currently incurable diseases. Their full-stack platform integrates proprietary bioprinting technology, therapeutic cells, biomaterials, and computational design to create next-generation cell therapies. These bioprinted tissues aim to replace, repair, or supplement biological functions, potentially transforming the treatment of diseases such as type 1 diabetes and liver diseases. Aspect’s innovative approach ensures biologically functional, immune-protective, and implantable solutions.

name: Biodel AG
description: Biodel AG is dedicated to improving farm incomes, soil health, and sequestering carbon from the atmosphere. The company offers a cost-effective solution for capturing CO₂ and revitalizing depleted soils through their innovative line of products, made with patented processes and exclusive blends that ensures farming practices are both sustainable and profitable. Pangaea exited Biodel in August 2026.

name: Boulder Ionics
description: Boulder Ionics, a developer and manufacturer of high-performance electrolytes for advanced energy storage devices, specialized in ultracapacitors, lithium-ion batteries, and metal-air batteries. Their non-toxic, non-flammable electrolytes were designed to perform across wide temperature ranges. In 2014, Boulder Ionics was acquired by CoorsTek Specialty Chemicals and now operates under the name CoorsTek Fluorochemicals, Inc.

name: Calysta
description: Calysta is a world leader in cellular agriculture, producing sustainable protein through a patented fermentation platform that doesn’t rely on arable land, plants, or animals.

name: CarbonCure
description: CarbonCure Technologies is on a mission to make concrete a climate solution. Their integrated decarbonization platform offers hardware, software, and services that help concrete producers cut their carbon footprint, lower production costs, and meet the growing demand for sustainable building materials. CarbonCure’s technology integrates seamlessly into existing plants, injecting captured CO₂ into the concrete mix, where it mineralizes permanently, reducing the need for cement and preventing CO₂ from re-entering the atmosphere.

name: ChEmpower
description: ChEmpower revolutionizes semiconductor manufacturing with their innovative chemically reactive pad technology that transforms the CMP process. Their elegant solution replaces complex abrasive slurries with advanced chemical technology, delivering substantial improvements in performance, cost, and sustainability. ChEmpower significantly reduces defects, water consumption, and waste while improving yields and simplifying processes. As the semiconductor industry advances, ChEmpower’s breakthrough technology positions them as essential partners in maintaining innovation momentum through more efficient and sustainable manufacturing solutions.

name: Cnano
description: Cnano is the world leader in carbon nanotube and conductive pastes, bringing critical technology to the U.S. A key component in lithium-ion batteries, Cnano's carbon nanotubes are essential for advanced energy storage and electric vehicle (EV) technology. With unmatched conductivity—10 to 100 times greater than standard additives—Cnano enables significant gains in battery performance, while maintaining a strong commitment to safety, environmental responsibility, and community engagement.

name: Correlia Biosystems
description: Correlia Biosystems creates advanced microscale tools for fast and precise biomolecule measurements. Their customizable PIXI​ platform requires just a tiny sample (less than two microliters) and delivers quick results, enabling dynamic monitoring of protein expression. These tools support data-driven biology by offering rapid, efficient measurement of proteins, helping researchers and clinicians access vital proteomic data, while reducing costs and speeding up the development of new therapeutics.

name: Cyrium Technologies
description: Cyrium Technologies led in the supply of Concentrator Photovoltaic (CPV) cells by reducing risks, lowering costs, and increasing profits for customers. The company specialized in fabless CPV cells, utilizing semiconductor technology to convert sunlight into electricity for terrestrial solar applications. By concentrating sunlight onto a small area of solar cells, Cyrium optimized performance and offered customization services through its Advanced Solar Cell Customization (ASCC) program, empowering the energy industry with high-efficiency solar solutions.

name: Dioseve
description: Dioseve is a biotechnology company building an iPS cell-based platform to reliably produce human oocytes and ovarian somatic cells, aiming to address some of the most persistent medical and societal challenges around fertility and pregnancy. By turning advanced stem cell biology into a practical toolset for reproductive medicine, Dioseve is creating new options that lessen the impact on patients and improve success rates.

name: Envia
description: Envia Systems developed and manufactured components to improve lithium-ion battery performance, focusing on high-energy density solutions for electric vehicle applications. The company pioneered silicon-based negative electrode materials, aiming to produce EV batteries that surpassed current technologies by 2-3 times. Envia's products supported various sectors, including consumer electronics, home and garden equipment, military devices, and satellites.

name: ESS
description: ESS Inc. is a leading provider of long-duration (6+ hours) energy storage solutions and has a 20+ year lifespan with no capacity loss It is made from abundant, safe materials like iron, salt, and water. This solution offers the lowest levelized cost of storage (LCOS) per kWh. ESS went public on the New York Stock Exchange in 2021.

name: Green Theme Technologies
description: Green Theme Technologies, Inc. is a pioneering company in sustainable textile and materials technology, committed to developing eco-friendly solutions that deliver high performance while reducing environmental impact. GTT’s proprietary technologies replace harmful PFAS chemicals in textiles, providing footwear and apparel brands with sustainable options that support a greener world. Focused on high-performance, cost-efficient coatings, Green Theme partners with industry leaders to drive sustainable innovation across global supply chains.

name: Hazel Technologies Inc
description: Hazel Technologies provides a simple way for growers, shippers, and retailers to extend the shelf life of produce. Their suite of technologies actively targets the primary, natural forces that accelerate produce spoilage, offering innovative, easy-to-use solutions that extend the quality of fruits and vegetables, reduce waste and increase profitability for some of the largest produce growers in the world.

name: Hinalea
description: Hinalea Imaging Corp. combines hyperspectral and digital imaging with advanced neural network analytics to provide data-rich images for quality assurance and testing. Their solutions are used in food safety, medical diagnostics, and precision agriculture. Hinalea also developed the world’s first high-resolution, handheld autonomous hyperspectral camera, which won the SPIE Best Camera and Imager Prism Award.

name: InMat
description: InMat Inc. developed and commercialized environmentally friendly, water-based nanocomposite barrier coatings for industries like tire manufacturing and packaging. Free of solvents and hazardous materials, these coatings were ideal for food packaging and could be applied via roll coating, spray, or dip processes. InMat’s proprietary technology provided air retention and chemical barriers, offering performance advantages across sporting goods, automotive, and protective equipment markets.

name: KANVAS
description: Kanvas Biosciences is on a mission to map and illuminate the microbial interactions foundational to the health of humanity. They use advanced imaging tools to provide deep insights into microbial life and develop novel therapeutics. Their full-stack technology platform features a spatial mapping discovery engine that captures detailed interactions and connections between the host and microbiome, uncovering new opportunities for effective therapeutic interventions and enhancing patient treatments.

name: Kovio
description: Kovio, Inc. developed and manufactured electronic devices using a proprietary printed silicon electronics platform. The company produced NFC tags for mobile marketing, authentication, and advertising, as well as electronic article surveillance (EAS) labels for anti-shoplifting applications. Originating from MIT's Media Lab, Kovio combined high-performance silicon inks with low-cost printing technology to create innovative solutions in retail operations, brand authentication, and ticketing. In 2014, Kovio's technology and assets were acquired by Thin Film Electronics ASA.

name: MEMBRION
description: Membrion provides adaptive water infrastructure that helps industrial facilities future-proof their operations. Breakthrough ceramic desalination technology enables manufacturers to recover clean water and critical minerals from the toughest waste streams, ensuring reliability in the face of regulatory shifts, climate pressures, and evolving production demands. Backed by leading investors and Fortune 500 partners, Membrion is shaping the future of industrial infrastructure, where resilience and sustainability are inseparable.

name: Modulim
description: Modulim delivers transformative imaging and data solutions that empower clinicians to better assess, manage, and preserve the lower limb. Their pioneering Clarifi® Imaging System uses spatial frequency domain imaging (SFDI) to noninvasively assess tissue and vascular health, identifying patients at risk for complications. By quantifying biomarkers of microvascular tissue oxygenation, the system enables early intervention, potentially saving limbs and lives. Clarifi is affordable and integrates easily into a clinician’s practice.

name: Nanox
description: Nanox Inc. developed nanostructured, high surface area perovskite-based catalysts for use in environmental emission controls. The principal application was based on the use of the complex, nanograin oxide, as the 3-way catalyst in catalytic converters and diesel oxidation.

name: Nautilus
description: Nautilus Data Technologies provides patented, facility-scale, liquid-cooling technology for AI/ML/HPC data centers. Its innovative EcoCore CDU and Infrastructure products deliver energy efficient, sustainable, scalable, cost-effective solutions for new/retrofit data center projects.

name: NewLeaf Symbiotics
description: NewLeaf Symbiotics is the pioneer of Pink-Pigmented Facultative Methylotrophs (PPFM) technology, using it to address challenges in yield, crop protection, nutrient efficiency, and methane mitigation. Their technology-powered products help farmers enhance productivity and sustainability, allowing them to do more with fewer resources. Integrated with existing crop management programs, NewLeaf's solutions improve the effectiveness of other crop inputs, delivering better results for growers.

name: NLM Photonics
description: Electro-Optic (EO) modulation is needed everywhere for next-generation communication and computing. Building on silicon photonics and other photonic integrated circuit (PIC) platforms, NLM’s modulation solution enables faster, energy-efficient movement of data across endpoints, devices, networks, and the internet.

name: pH7 Technologies
description: pH7 Technologies specializes in SolvoMetallurgy research, a new branch of extractive metallurgy. They innovate, design, and improve processes to develop proprietary methods for cost-effective and sustainable metal extraction from both primary and secondary resources. Their advanced technology focuses on the high-yield, eco-friendly extraction of Platinum Group Metals (PGMs) from spent catalysts and other sources, supporting the transition to green energy and enhancing the circular economy.

name: Pionetics
description: Pionetics was a leading innovator in water technology, specializing in smart water treatment products for residential, commercial, and industrial use. Its ion exchange technology effectively removed priority pollutants and softened water without salt, delivering great-tasting, safe drinking water with less wastewater than traditional systems. Pionetics was acquired by Rayne Corporation in 2008.

name: polySpectra
description: polySpectra is an advanced materials company that helps innovative engineers 3D print end-use components that they can trust, using the world’s most rugged photopolymer resins. Their modular chemical platform unlocks additive polymers with a broad spectrum of tailored engineering properties. polySpectra has been supported by the Advanced Manufacturing Office, the National Science Foundation and the Molecular Foundry.

name: Prime Roots
description: Prime Roots is redefining the deli meat counter with clean protein made from mycelium, a nutrient-rich, natural protein source. Their products are free from nitrates and ultra-processing, offering a wholesome alternative without compromising flavor or texture. Mycelium provides a complete protein that grows muscle faster than meat protein and is naturally high in fiber, boosting the nutrition profile.

name: Redlen
description: Redlen Technologies leads in multi-energy, radiation imaging modules using proprietary Cadmium Zinc Telluride (CZT) sensors. Specializing in Photon Counting detector solutions for Computed Tomography (PCCT), Redlen is the sole merchant supplier of PCCT detectors in clinical use. Its modules combine advanced CZT material with sophisticated electronics for global Fortune 500 clients in medical, security, and non-destructive testing markets. In September 2021, Redlen became a wholly owned subsidiary of Canon Inc.

name: RSI
description: RSI reduced the cost of solar panels with its patented cadmium telluride (CdTe) electroplating process, which was two-thirds less expensive than traditional silicon for the same output. The company’s larger CdTe modules further cut manufacturing and installation costs. RSI provided technology, tools, and expertise to photovoltaic leaders and developed the Rapid Efficient Electroplating on Large-areas (REEL) process. It partnered with regional manufacturers to deliver cost-effective, locally produced photovoltaic modules.

name: Semprus
description: Semprus BioSciences developed a permanent antimicrobial coating technology for medical devices, designed to prevent bacterial colonization on devices of various sizes, shapes, and materials. The company focused on creating the first dual-functional vascular access catheter to combat both bacteria and blood clots, improving patient outcomes. Teleflex acquired Semprus BioSciences in 2012.

name: Sun Genomics
description: Floré offers a groundbreaking approach to gut health with its advanced microbiome testing and customized formulations. By combining over 100 prebiotics, probiotics, and botanical ingredients, Floré creates tailored solutions that address dysbiosis—a condition linked to numerous chronic diseases, affecting over 80% of Americans annually. Floré empowers consumers to make informed choices with precision-crafted formulas that go beyond general solutions.

name: SWITCH Materials
description: SWITCH developed innovative materials with organic molecules that changed optical properties on command. Their photochromic-electrochromic technology allowed sunroofs to automatically darken in sunlight, cutting heat and glare. This technology was used in automotive and architectural glass, eyewear, and more, enabling on-demand adjustments with a small electric current.

name: Tactus
description: Tactus developed innovative touch technologies and designed self-healing, anti-scratch, and impact-resistant protective layers for foldable, wearable, and rollable electronics, offering exceptional bend performance. Their TrueWrite Film improved writing experiences with enhanced tactile feedback, while patented shatter protection provided a pen-on-paper feel.

name: Tidal Vision
description: Tidal Vision is a world-leading chitosan biomolecular solutions provider that delivers solutions to humanity's greatest chemistry and pollution challenges in the water treatment, agriculture, and material industries. Tidal Vision is composed of the following commercial divisions: Tidal Clear®, Clear Water Services™, Tidal Grow®, and Tidal-Tec®.

name: Tivra Corporation
description: Tivra Corporation developed microelectronics, semiconductors, and LED products. The company’s technology platform offered LED-based electronic materials, focusing on improving cost and performance in LED and nitride power electronics.

name: TruTag Technologies
description: TruTag has the world’s only digitization platform that combines secure edible barcodes—TruTags®—with consumer-friendly mobile apps to tag, track, and trace drugs, life-critical consumables, and other products. Using advanced cGMP nano-porous silica manufacturing, this technology supports product authentication across diverse industries, including pharmaceuticals, food, consumer products, and industrial and electronic parts.

name: Versogen
description: Versogen systems are engineered to make hydrogen affordable and sustainable. Their breakthrough electrolyzer technology uses water and renewable energy to produce green hydrogen at scale—reliably and affordably. Built with patented anion exchange membranes (AEM) and earth-abundant materials, Versogen's solutions are designed to significantly reduce industrial carbon emissions and support a sustainable energy future - leading the global transition to hydrogen with innovative and scalable technologies.

name: Vestaron
description: Vestaron is transforming crop protection with advanced peptide-based insecticides from spider and other venomous animal venoms. These new insecticides offer effective pest control while being safe and sustainable for pollinators, beneficials, and local biodiversity. Their first product, SPEAR® LEP, is used on over 650,000 acres and has been approved in the EU to combat tomato leafminer pests. In 2024, the EPA also approved their new insecticide, BASIN®. Vestaron was acquired by Suterra in May 2026.

With installations in prominent buildings, Artus is poised for global growth, providing a more efficient, space-saving, and cost-effective solution for modern HVAC needs.

name: Atomik
description: Atomik AM creates sustainable materials and patented technologies to support scalable and efficient advanced manufacturing, such as a Universal Binder – or glue – to supercharge 3D printing across automotive, aerospace and energy. The company prides itself on a materials-first, solutions focused approach that takes a holistic approach to advanced manufacturing instead of solving individual problems.

name: Audiebant
description: Audiebant specialises in mass communications solutions which can be used to issue vital information or critical alerts to ensure public safety. For example, during an act of terrorism or extreme weather. Audiebant can deliver communications via audio networks, mobiles, PCs and outdoor tech (including digital displays).

name: Aveni
description: Aveni is an award-winning AI FinTech company specialising in developing generative AI tools and LLMs for the Financial Services sector. Its advanced core products, Detect, Assist and Docs, are developed by top AI researchers and engineers. Aveni’s platform merges cutting-edge AI with human expertise to enhance productivity by up to 3x, offering solutions for automated admin support, quality assurance, performance assessment, and Consumer Duty management, driving a new era of hyper-efficiency in financial services.

name: Axol Bioscience
description: Axol Bioscience is a biotechnology company that leverages advanced cell technology to help researchers develop safer, more effective drugs. The company offers contract research services using advanced iPSC technology to create diverse human cell types from small tissue samples. This technology is crucial for studying diseases like Alzheimer’s, where obtaining living tissue is difficult. It supports drug discovery in neurodegenerative, neuroinflammatory, and cardiotoxicity areas, providing high-quality in vitro models and custom lab services to major biopharma companies globally. Its expertise in neuro-inflammation and pain research attracts clients from Europe, the US, and Japan, driving life science discovery forward with innovative, human-relevant models.

name: BankiFi
description: BankiFi is a fintech company that aims to alleviate the common headaches SMEs face when operating a business. Its platform, which is sold to banks to help them better service SMEs, rolls invoicing, payments, collections, accounting and tax into one.

name: BidScript
description: BidScript is a Manchester-based AI-native tender management platform that helps businesses find, qualify, manage, write, and submit bids for public and private sector contracts. Built to replace the manual, spreadsheet-driven processes still used across the bidding industry, BidScript focuses on demanding tendering environments including construction and engineering, IT, and education. Early customers across the UK, US, and Middle East have improved their win rates by up to 50% using the platform’s AI-based workflow automation. Founded by Henry Brogan and Tyler McCarthy, BidScript is now expanding its product suite and entering new domestic and international markets.

name: BlueSkeye
description: BlueSkeye AI is leading advancements in the digital health and wellbeing space through artificial intelligence and machine learning. Through its expertise, the company is making it easier to detect and diagnose mental health conditions and enhance people’s wellbeing.
